entry.alpha_decision: The native RGBA is 2048x2048 with extrema 0..254. Counts are 0=1922030, 252=802490, 253=1375456, 254=1326 and 255=0. Full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparisons show genuine exterior transparency around the complete frame/note silhouette without visible interior holes, lost backing, cloth transparency or a working-matte halo. Internal 252-254 values alone are not rejection grounds under visible-alpha-v1.
entry.visible_limitations: The small cap and collar insignia motifs and note glyphs are not reliably readable at 65x67. Approval covers the visible group count, relative lengths, hair, clothing, collar and actual alpha, not invented lettering or exact microscopic heraldry.
